title: Supreme Pickaxe 3x3
description: ✨ The ultimate 3×3 pickaxe plugin for Paper & Spigot. Fully customizable area, lightweight code, and easy configuration!
body:
# ⛏️ Supreme Pickaxe 3×3

**Supreme Pickaxe 3×3** is the ultimate mining solution for your Minecraft server. Grant your players the power to clear massive areas instantly with a fully customizable, high-performance 3×3 pickaxe. Perfect for survival, skyblock, or prison servers!

---

## 🛡️ Advanced WorldGuard Integration

You don't have to worry about players destroying your spawn, cities, or custom maps! The plugin features native, smart integration with **WorldGuard**:

* **Total Protection:** If a player tries to mine in a restricted area, the plugin will respect your server settings and block the destruction.
* **Smart Fragmented Mining:** Perfect for custom mines (`/warp mina`)! If a 3×3 break radius overlaps two different regions, the plugin dynamically checks the flags. It will **only destroy blocks** inside the region with `block-break true` and completely protect the blocks inside the region with `block-break false`. No glitches, no exploits!

---

## ✨ Features

* **Custom Mining Area:** Easily break blocks in a 3×3 area (or fully customize the radius within the configuration).
* **High Performance:** Lightweight code designed to handle mass block breaking without causing server lag.
* **Fully Customizable:** Modify messages, permissions, and settings to fit your server's needs perfectly.
* **Command-Driven:** Give items directly to players with built-in enchantment support.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/pico3x3 [Player] [Enchantments] [Level]` | Gives a custom 3×3 pickaxe to a specific player with optional enchants. | `op` |
| `/pico3x3 reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration dynamically. | `op` |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Take a look at how simple it is to tweak the plugin to your liking. 
👉 [View Default config.yml](https://github.com/SrBanannitoTK/Supreme-Pickaxe-3x3-plugin/blob/src/src/main/resources/config.yml)

---

## 📈 Compatibility & Platforms

* **Supported Versions:** Minecraft Java Edition `26.1.2`
* **Supported Platforms:** Spigot & Paper
* **Optional Dependencies:** WorldGuard (Highly recommended for region control!)
